<p id="mwCQ">The <b id="mwCg">Samsung Galaxy A18</b> is an <a rel="mw:WikiLink" href="https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Android_(operating_system)" title="Android (operating system)" id="mwCw">Android</a> based <a rel="mw:WikiLink" href="https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Smartphone" title="Smartphone" id="mwDA">smartphone</a> developed and marketed by <a rel="mw:WikiLink" href="https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Samsung_Electronics" title="Samsung Electronics" id="mwDQ">Samsung</a> in 2026. The <b id="mwDg">LTE variant</b> was announced on September 15, 2026.<sup about="#mwt12" class="mw-ref reference" id="cite_ref-:1_2-0" rel="dc:references" typeof="mw:Extension/ref" data-mw="{"name":"ref","attrs":{"name":":1"}}"><a href="#cite_note-:1-2" id="mwDw"><span class="mw-reflink-text" id="mwEA"><span class="cite-bracket" id="mwEQ">[</span>2<span class="cite-bracket" id="mwEg">]</span></span></a></sup><sup about="#mwt13" class="mw-ref reference" id="cite_ref-:4_3-0" rel="dc:references" typeof="mw:Extension/ref" data-mw="{"name":"ref","attrs":{"name":":4"}}"><a href="#cite_note-:4-3" id="mwEw"><span class="mw-reflink-text" id="mwFA"><span class="cite-bracket" id="mwFQ">[</span>3<span class="cite-bracket" id="mwFg">]</span></span></a></sup> The phone is part of the <a rel="mw:WikiLink" href="https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Samsung_Galaxy_A_series" title="Samsung Galaxy A series" id="mwFw">Samsung Galaxy A series</a>.</p>

<meta property="mw:PageProp/toc" id="mwGA" data-mw="{"autoGenerated":true}"></section><section data-mw-section-id="1" id="mwGQ" aria-labelledby="Specifications"><div class="mw-heading mw-heading2"><h2 id="Specifications">Specifications</h2><span class="mw-editsection"><span class="mw-editsection-bracket">[</span><a href="/w/index.php?title=Samsung_Galaxy_A18&action=edit&section=1" title="Edit section: Specifications"><span>edit</span></a><span class="mw-editsection-bracket">]</span></span></div>

<section data-mw-section-id="2" id="mwGg" aria-labelledby="Design"><div class="mw-heading mw-heading3"><h3 id="Design">Design</h3><span class="mw-editsection"><span class="mw-editsection-bracket">[</span><a href="/w/index.php?title=Samsung_Galaxy_A18&action=edit&section=2" title="Edit section: Design"><span>edit</span></a><span class="mw-editsection-bracket">]</span></span></div>
<p id="mwGw">The LTE model continues to have a similar rear (camera layout) and Key Island design, similar to <a rel="mw:WikiLink" href="https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Samsung_Galaxy_A17" title="Samsung Galaxy A17" id="mwHA">Samsung Galaxy A17</a> being its predecessor.<sup about="#mwt16" class="mw-ref reference" id="cite_ref-:1_2-1" rel="dc:references" typeof="mw:Extension/ref" data-mw="{"name":"ref","attrs":{"name":":1"},"body":{"id":"mw-reference-text-cite_note-:1-2"}}"><a href="#cite_note-:1-2" id="mwHQ"><span class="mw-reflink-text" id="mwHg"><span class="cite-bracket" id="mwHw">[</span>2<span class="cite-bracket" id="mwIA">]</span></span></a></sup><sup about="#mwt19" class="mw-ref reference" id="cite_ref-:4_3-1" rel="dc:references" typeof="mw:Extension/ref" data-mw="{"name":"ref","attrs":{"name":":4"},"body":{"id":"mw-reference-text-cite_note-:4-3"}}"><a href="#cite_note-:4-3" id="mwIQ"><span class="mw-reflink-text" id="mwIg"><span class="cite-bracket" id="mwIw">[</span>3<span class="cite-bracket" id="mwJA">]</span></span></a></sup></p>

</section><section data-mw-section-id="3" id="mwLQ" aria-labelledby="Hardware"><div class="mw-heading mw-heading3"><h3 id="Hardware">Hardware</h3><span class="mw-editsection"><span class="mw-editsection-bracket">[</span><a href="/w/index.php?title=Samsung_Galaxy_A18&action=edit&section=3" title="Edit section: Hardware"><span>edit</span></a><span class="mw-editsection-bracket">]</span></span></div>

<section data-mw-section-id="4" id="mwLg" aria-labelledby="Display"><div class="mw-heading mw-heading4"><h4 id="Display">Display</h4><span class="mw-editsection"><span class="mw-editsection-bracket">[</span><a href="/w/index.php?title=Samsung_Galaxy_A18&action=edit&section=4" title="Edit section: Display"><span>edit</span></a><span class="mw-editsection-bracket">]</span></span></div>
<p id="mwLw">The device continues to use the same 6.7-inch Super AMOLED display from its predecessor.<sup about="#mwt24" class="mw-ref reference" id="cite_ref-:2_4-0" rel="dc:references" typeof="mw:Extension/ref" data-mw="{"name":"ref","attrs":{"name":":2"},"body":{"id":"mw-reference-text-cite_note-:2-4"}}"><a href="#cite_note-:2-4" id="mwMA"><span class="mw-reflink-text" id="mwMQ"><span class="cite-bracket" id="mwMg">[</span>4<span class="cite-bracket" id="mwMw">]</span></span></a></sup> The screen protection was downgraded to <a rel="mw:WikiLink" href="https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Gorilla_Glass" title="Gorilla Glass" id="mwNA">Corning Gorilla Glass 3</a>, from the Corning Gorilla Glass Victus on its predecessor.<sup about="#mwt27" class="mw-ref reference" id="cite_ref-:3_5-0" rel="dc:references" typeof="mw:Extension/ref" data-mw="{"name":"ref","attrs":{"name":":3"},"body":{"id":"mw-reference-text-cite_note-:3-5"}}"><a href="#cite_note-:3-5" id="mwNQ"><span class="mw-reflink-text" id="mwNg"><span class="cite-bracket" id="mwNw">[</span>5<span class="cite-bracket" id="mwOA">]</span></span></a></sup></p>

</section><section data-mw-section-id="5" id="mwOQ" aria-labelledby="Battery"><div class="mw-heading mw-heading4"><h4 id="Battery">Battery</h4><span class="mw-editsection"><span class="mw-editsection-bracket">[</span><a href="/w/index.php?title=Samsung_Galaxy_A18&action=edit&section=5" title="Edit section: Battery"><span>edit</span></a><span class="mw-editsection-bracket">]</span></span></div>
<p id="mwOg">The device has a 5000<span typeof="mw:Entity" id="mwOw"> </span>mAh battery and 25<span typeof="mw:Entity" id="mwPA"> </span>W fast charging support, just as its previous predecessors.<sup about="#mwt30" class="mw-ref reference" id="cite_ref-6" rel="dc:references" typeof="mw:Extension/ref" data-mw="{"name":"ref","attrs":{},"body":{"id":"mw-reference-text-cite_note-6"}}"><a href="#cite_note-6" id="mwPQ"><span class="mw-reflink-text" id="mwPg"><span class="cite-bracket" id="mwPw">[</span>6<span class="cite-bracket" id="mwQA">]</span></span></a></sup></p>

</section><section data-mw-section-id="6" id="mwQQ" aria-labelledby="Performance"><div class="mw-heading mw-heading4"><h4 id="Performance">Performance</h4><span class="mw-editsection"><span class="mw-editsection-bracket">[</span><a href="/w/index.php?title=Samsung_Galaxy_A18&action=edit&section=6" title="Edit section: Performance"><span>edit</span></a><span class="mw-editsection-bracket">]</span></span></div>
<p id="mwQg">The LTE variant uses the <a rel="mw:WikiLink" href="https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Exynos" title="Exynos" id="mwQw">Exynos</a> 1610 system-on-a-chip (SoC), which would have been the first model to have an Exynos chipset since the LTE variant of the <a rel="mw:WikiLink" href="https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Samsung_Galaxy_A14" title="Samsung Galaxy A14" id="mwRA">Galaxy A14</a>.<sup about="#mwt33" class="mw-ref reference" id="cite_ref-7" rel="dc:references" typeof="mw:Extension/ref" data-mw="{"name":"ref","attrs":{},"body":{"id":"mw-reference-text-cite_note-7"}}"><a href="#cite_note-7" id="mwRQ"><span class="mw-reflink-text" id="mwRg"><span class="cite-bracket" id="mwRw">[</span>7<span class="cite-bracket" id="mwSA">]</span></span></a></sup></p>

<p id="mwSQ">For unknown reasons, the 64 GB internal storage option returned (a first since the <a rel="mw:WikiLink" href="https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Samsung_Galaxy_A14" title="Samsung Galaxy A14" id="mwSg">Galaxy A14</a>) alongside 128<span typeof="mw:Entity" id="mwSw"> </span>GB or 256<span typeof="mw:Entity" id="mwTA"> </span>GB storage options (all of which uses UFS 2.2),<sup about="#mwt36" class="mw-ref reference" id="cite_ref-8" rel="dc:references" typeof="mw:Extension/ref" data-mw="{"name":"ref","attrs":{},"body":{"id":"mw-reference-text-cite_note-8"}}"><a href="#cite_note-8" id="mwTQ"><span class="mw-reflink-text" id="mwTg"><span class="cite-bracket" id="mwTw">[</span>8<span class="cite-bracket" id="mwUA">]</span></span></a></sup> while memory options (4<span typeof="mw:Entity" id="mwUQ"> </span>GB, 6<span typeof="mw:Entity" id="mwUg"> </span>GB or 8<span typeof="mw:Entity" id="mwUw"> </span>GB) are similar to its predecessors.<sup about="#mwt37" class="mw-ref reference" id="cite_ref-:2_4-1" rel="dc:references" typeof="mw:Extension/ref" data-mw="{"name":"ref","attrs":{"name":":2"}}"><a href="#cite_note-:2-4" id="mwVA"><span class="mw-reflink-text" id="mwVQ"><span class="cite-bracket" id="mwVg">[</span>4<span class="cite-bracket" id="mwVw">]</span></span></a></sup> It continues to have a <a rel="mw:WikiLink" href="https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/MicroSDXC" title="MicroSDXC" class="mw-redirect" id="mwWA">microSDXC</a> card slot.</p>

</section><section data-mw-section-id="7" id="mwWQ" aria-labelledby="Camera"><div class="mw-heading mw-heading4"><h4 id="Camera">Camera</h4><span class="mw-editsection"><span class="mw-editsection-bracket">[</span><a href="/w/index.php?title=Samsung_Galaxy_A18&action=edit&section=7" title="Edit section: Camera"><span>edit</span></a><span class="mw-editsection-bracket">]</span></span></div>
<p id="mwWg">The A18 uses the same cameras as its predecessors: 50 MP primary rear camera, 5 MP ultrawide, 2 MP macro back cameras and 13 MP front cameras.<sup about="#mwt38" class="mw-ref reference" id="cite_ref-:3_5-1" rel="dc:references" typeof="mw:Extension/ref" data-mw="{"name":"ref","attrs":{"name":":3"}}"><a href="#cite_note-:3-5" id="mwWw"><span class="mw-reflink-text" id="mwXA"><span class="cite-bracket" id="mwXQ">[</span>5<span class="cite-bracket" id="mwXg">]</span></span></a></sup></p>

</section></section><section data-mw-section-id="8" id="mwgQ" aria-labelledby="Software"><div class="mw-heading mw-heading3"><h3 id="Software">Software</h3><span class="mw-editsection"><span class="mw-editsection-bracket">[</span><a href="/w/index.php?title=Samsung_Galaxy_A18&action=edit&section=8" title="Edit section: Software"><span>edit</span></a><span class="mw-editsection-bracket">]</span></span></div>
<p id="mwgg">The A18 originally came with <a rel="mw:WikiLink" href="https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Android_17" title="Android 17" id="mwgw">Android 17</a> with <a rel="mw:WikiLink" href="https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/One_UI#One_UI_9" title="One UI" id="mwhA">One UI 9</a> out of the box. It is scheduled to receive 6 major software updates and 6 years of security updates, ceasing to receive further major updates in 2032.<sup about="#mwt41" class="mw-ref reference" id="cite_ref-:5_9-0" rel="dc:references" typeof="mw:Extension/ref" data-mw="{"name":"ref","attrs":{"name":":5"},"body":{"id":"mw-reference-text-cite_note-:5-9"}}"><a href="#cite_note-:5-9" id="mwhQ"><span class="mw-reflink-text" id="mwhg"><span class="cite-bracket" id="mwhw">[</span>9<span class="cite-bracket" id="mwiA">]</span></span></a></sup></p>
